content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the incomplete implementation of 64-bit I/O operations for the parisc architecture. The previous commit only added functions for reading and writing 64-bit values in a high-low order (ioread64_hi_lo and iowrite64_hi_lo), but did not implement the corresponding low-high order functions (ioread64_lo_hi and iowrite64_lo_hi). This oversight led to potential issues when the kernel attempted to use these operations, resulting in reports from the kernel test robot. The patch addresses this by adding the missing functions to ensure proper handling of 64-bit I/O in both orders.
